definitions.ask: When `n` finds no pinned Create row, should it show a toast explaining why instead of doing nothing?
definitions.why: the silent no-op is why this race was hard to diagnose

choices.label: Toast why `n` can't create yet (checking, or unsupported, press R); adds one docs sentence
Keep `n` a silent no-op without a Create row; only the race fix and its tests land
